title: SSLfmm: An R Package for Semi-Supervised Learning with Mixed Missingness
abstract: arXiv:2512.03322v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Partially labelled samples arise when features are observed for all data, but class labels are available for only a subset. In such settings, the mechanism governing label availability may itself contain information relevant to classification, yet it is typically left unmodelled in standard semi-supervised learning procedures. The SSLfmm package implements likelihood-based Gaussian finite-mixture classification in which the label-missingness process is modelled jointly with the class distribution. It supports complete-case, missing completely at random (MCAR), entropy-based missing at random (MAR), and mixed MCAR/MAR analyses. For the mixed mechanism, the source of a missing label may be observed or latent, allowing the same modelling framework to accommodate different forms of information about label availability. A common R interface is provided for model fitting, prediction, performance assessment, simulation, and entropy-ba

translated_title: SSLfmm：一个用于混合缺失机制半监督学习的R包
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.03322v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：当所有数据的特征都被观测到，但仅有部分样本的类别标签可用时，就会出现部分标记样本。在这种情况下，控制标签可用性的机制本身可能包含与分类相关的信息，但在标准的半监督学习流程中通常未被建模。SSLfmm包实现了基于似然的高斯有限混合分类，其中标签缺失过程与类别分布联合建模。它支持完全案例、完全随机缺失（MCAR）、基于熵的随机缺失（MAR）以及混合MCAR/MAR分析。对于混合机制，缺失标签的来源可能是可观测的或潜在的，允许同一建模框架适应关于标签可用性的不同形式信息。该包提供了一个统一的R接口，用于模型拟合、预测、性能评估、模拟和基于熵的分析。
tldr: SSLfmm是一个R包，通过联合建模标签缺失机制与类别分布，支持混合缺失机制下的半监督学习，并提供了统一的R接口。
en_tdlr: SSLfmm is an R package that jointly models label-missingness mechanisms with class distributions for semi-supervised learning under mixed missingness, offering a unified R interface.
